note: A pivotal accusation before the whole guild, run at a middle tier.
playerLine: I accuse the harbourmaster before the whole guild and call the watch to witness.
narration: The hall falls quiet in widening rings. The harbourmaster does not move, and a vein stands out on his temple. At the back two members of the watch exchange a look and step forward, waiting for someone to say what happens next.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
